description: Small autosave state machine inspired by CKEditor pending action and autosave behavior.

members.name: DebounceElapsed
members.description: Starts a save when the debounce interval elapsed.

members.name: ResetSynchronized
members.description: Resets the state machine after a document load or explicit synchronization.

members.name: Retry
members.description: Starts a retry after a recoverable save error.

members.name: SaveFailed
members.description: Marks the current save as failed.

members.name: SaveSucceeded
members.description: Marks the current save as successful.
